headline: Bangladesh vows to arrest former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina if she returns from India
label: NEWS
caption:
Bangladesh has issued a severe warning to former leader Sheikh Hasina ahead of her planned return ⚠️

State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaed Islam told Reuters that Bangladesh will arrest and jail former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina if she returns from India.

Hasina has been residing in India since fleeing Bangladesh in 2024, and her announcement to return in December has triggered political tension and renewed street violence.

Dhaka is also seeking Hasina's extradition from India and expects New Delhi to comply with an existing extradition treaty, according to government officials.

Meanwhile, politician Tarique Rahman is actively rallying political parties against Hasina's Awami League party as political instability deepens.
